news.headline: Tesla Accused of Misleading Marketing of Full Self-Driving in South Korea
news.summary: A South Korean consumer group has announced plans to file a complaint against Tesla, alleging the company engaged in deceptive marketing regarding its automated-driving technology.

news.headline: Tesla Shares Decline Amidst US Midterm Election Results
news.summary: Tesla shares experienced downward pressure following US midterm election results that saw Democratic gains, sparking investor concerns regarding potential regulatory scrutiny.

news.headline: TSLA, SPCX Sink Over 4% as Democrats Flip Texas: What's Going On?
news.summary: SpaceX and Tesla shares fell after Texas Democrats’ wins raised doubts about Musk-backed AI data centers and the companies’ prospects.

news.headline: Amazon Reports AWS Financials and Strategic AI Updates
news.summary: Amazon disclosed key AWS performance metrics, including $46 billion in quarterly revenue, and announced plans to expand the availability of its Trainium chips.

news.headline: AWS Launches 'Semarak AI Malaysia' National Program
news.summary: Amazon Web Services introduced a national initiative in Malaysia to provide AI tools and training to government, businesses, and students.

news.headline: SUNGBOON EDITOR Receives 2026 Amazon Innovator Award
news.summary: Korean skincare brand SUNGBOON EDITOR was named a recipient of the 2026 Amazon Innovator Award following strong commercial performance and successful collaboration with the platform.

news.headline: Apple Issues December-Quarter Revenue Guidance and Warns of Margin Pressures
news.summary: Apple Inc. projected 7%–10% revenue growth for the December quarter while cautioning that rising memory and storage costs may impact profit margins.

news.headline: DZ Bank Downgrades Apple to Sell
news.summary: DZ Bank has downgraded Apple Inc. from "Hold" to "Sell," setting a price target of $300.

news.headline: Apple Announces AI-Powered Health App and Developer Tools
news.summary: Apple unveiled a redesigned, AI-powered Health app and new developer tools for Siri AI integration, with features set to roll out in upcoming software updates.
